name: Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
proof: A positive non-clashing teacher mapping is a non-clashing teacher mapping with an additional restriction on its samples.  Minimizing over the restricted class cannot lower the optimum.
witness_verification: On the $n$-dimensional full cube, positive no-clashing teaching dimension is $n$, whereas ordinary no-clashing teaching dimension is $\lceil n/2\rceil$. The gap is unbounded.
